ud1.8:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
ud1.8:1.3: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Saṅgāmaji Sāvatthiṃ anuppatto hoti bhagavantaṃ dassanāya.
ud1.8:2.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Saṅgāmaji aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle divāvihāraṃ nisinno hoti.
ud1.8:2.2: atha kho āyasmato Saṅgāmajissa purāṇadutiyikā yena āyasmā Saṅgāmaji ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Saṅgāmajiṃ etad avoca: Khudda
ud1.8:2.4: evaṃ vutte āyasmā Saṅgāmaji tuṇhī ahosi
ud1.8:3.1: dutiyam pi kho āyasmato Saṅgāmajissa purāṇadutiyikā āyasmantaṃ Saṅgāmajiṃ etad avoca: Khuddaputtaṃ
ud1.8:3.3: dutiyam pi kho āyasmā Saṅgāmaji tuṇhī ahosi.
ud1.8:4.1: tatiyam pi kho āyasmato Saṅgāmajissa purāṇadutiyikā āyasmantaṃ Saṅgāmajiṃ etad avoca: khuddaputtaṃ
ud1.8:4.3: tatiyam pi kho āyasmā Saṅgāmaji tuṇhī ahosi.
ud1.8:5.1: atha kho āyasmato Saṅgāmajissa purāṇadutiyikā taṃ dārakaṃ āyasmato Saṅgāmajissa purato nikkhipitvā pakkāmi:
ud1.8:5.2: eso te samaṇa putto, posa nan ti.
ud1.8:6.1: atha kho āyasmā Saṅgāmaji taṃ dārakaṃ neva olokesi nāpi ālapi.
ud1.8:6.2: atha kho āyasmato Saṅgāmajissa purāṇadutiyikā avidūre gantvā apalokentī addas' āyasmantaṃ Saṅgāmajiṃ taṃ dārakaṃ neva olokentaṃ nāpi ālapantaṃ, disvān 'assā etad ahosi:
ud1.8:6.3: na c' āyaṃ samaṇo puttena pi atthiko 'ti
ud1.8:6.5: addasā kho bhagavā dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena āyasmato Saṅgāmajissa purāṇadutiyikāya evarūpaṃ vippakāraṃ.
ud1.8:7.1: atha kho bhagavā etam atthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
